title: Gault - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Gault in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Three elements matter: Fire lands, Ice and Lightning are resisted, Earth heals it.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toFire
ResistsIce, Lightning
AbsorbsEarth
ImmuneNone

Bring Fire damage. Ice, Lightning is resisted, so those turns are wasted. Earth is absorbed - using it heals the target.

sections.title: How to Beat the Gault
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Fire is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It absorbs Earth, so that element heals it rather than hurting it.
  • It resists Ice, Lightning, so that damage is halved.
